key_entities: classification enum: env_setup, dependency, integration, tooling, none
propositions: An optional isolated adapter must extract and classify error signatures from local Claude Code transcript JSONL files without invoking an LLM or requiring network calls, using only deterministic keyword/regex routing.

The adapter classification must route known error patterns (ModuleNotFoundError, ConnectionError, pip resolution errors, git/linting failures) to the correct enum value (env_setup, dependency, integration, tooling) with every emitted record labeled source=backfill_classified, confidence=classified.
The core metrics package (registry.py, __init__.py) must not import the transcript adapter to maintain portability and ensure the adapter is quarantined to the optional backfill script.

A backfill script must invoke the adapter over fixture transcript directories and emit classified records, and a unit test must verify extraction and classification of known error signatures produce labeled output while clean transcripts yield zero results.
The adapter module must define the classification enum with exactly five values and the JSON schema with kind, signature, ts, source, and confidence fields, all enforced by unit test assertions.
